stem:
Meena's mother took a steel glass of cold milk out of the refrigerator. After a few minutes, Meena saw tiny droplets of water on the outside of the glass.

Which change of state explains these droplets?

options.text: water vapour in the air condensing on the cold glass
milk inside the glass evaporating into the air
the cold glass melting into liquid water
water inside the glass freezing into droplets

teacher.key_rationale: Droplets form because water vapour in the surrounding air cools on contact with the cold glass and condenses to liquid. Options B, C and D describe melting, evaporation or freezing, none of which produce droplets on the outside of the glass.
